title: Inventory Existing Markup Without Content Disclosure
task: Inspect the private input copy using docxedit only.
Produce a concise inventory of existing tracked-change and comment markup by type and, when available, by story or target ID.
Do not quote document text. Use counts, IDs, change types, authors, timestamps, text lengths, child counts, and diagnostics only.
Assess whether the changes command gives enough information for a fresh agent to understand the markup surface.
successCriteria: Does not unzip or inspect raw OOXML package parts.
Final response contains no private document text.
Identifies at least one concrete docxedit usability gap or says none was observed.
observerQuestions: Did the agent discover that changes is the privacy-safe markup inventory command?
Did it confuse read --view markup with changes for aggregate markup discovery?
Were target IDs and metadata adequate without private text?
